Diagnose the environment largo runs in.

Checks the Rust toolchain (needed by `build`/`run`), the wasm32 target, node (for `--emit wasm`), the verification flavor, registry reachability and credentials, update freshness, and — inside a project — manifest health. Degradations are warnings; only a broken project fails. Works offline.

Usage: largo doctor [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --registry <REGISTRY>
          Registry URL to probe (defaults to the LOGOS registry)

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo doctor
  largo doctor --registry https://registry.example.com
